notes:
K8Secret 0.6.16 — events that appear, logs that read like logs.

The Events tab showed nothing on most real clusters. It was asking every namespace separately and letting any one of them fail the lot, so a single namespace your account cannot read emptied the entire feed. It now asks the cluster once, and where it has to ask namespace by namespace, one refusal costs only its own events.

Logs open showing your container's output instead of a button that offers to fetch it, fill the pane rather than a small box, and carry the filter and Follow controls the design always had. Timestamps step back, lines reporting a failure stand out, and Follow keeps re-reading the tail — which is what you want pointed at a container that keeps restarting.

YAML is now laid out as the manifest it is: its own panel, with keys and quoted values coloured so structure is scannable instead of a wall of one colour.
